verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this story is a community report that a built-in Windows Search exists. That same report says two consecutive updates broke Search for users who had disabled web results, which undercuts the 'instant' and reliable part of the story. No first-party docs in the pack describe the search launcher or what it covers. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a global search launcher covering files, apps, and settings, evidence of instant or fast results, and hands-on corroboration of reliability.
